summary: This law authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, during fiscal year 2026. It sets a maximum spending limit of $1,762,668,000 for the project, which includes building a new bed tower, expanding clinical buildings, constructing a consolidated administrative building and warehouse, a utility plant, and parking garages.

affected_groups.effect: Receives authorization to carry out and receive appropriations for a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, up to $1,762,668,000.

key_provisions: Authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, in fiscal year 2026.
Details that the project includes the construction of a new bed tower, clinical building expansion, consolidated administrative building and warehouse, utility plant, and parking garages.
Sets a maximum expenditure and authorization of appropriations of $1,762,668,000 for the project under the Construction, Major Projects account.
missing_information: Specific timeline or completion date for the construction project beyond fiscal year 2026.
Details on how many veterans will be served by the new facility.
summary_detail.plain_summary: This law authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, during fiscal year 2026. summary_detail.significance: The law authorizes a specific, multi-building medical facility construction project for the Department of Veterans Affairs in St. Louis with an authorized funding cap of $1,762,668,000.
